info.title: Studio Platform API
info.description: Shared backend for the photography, podcast and events websites, the admin panel and the future mobile app. Authentication endpoints are provided by Better Auth under /api/auth/* (sign-up/email, sign-in/email, sign-out, get-session, request-password-reset, reset-password).
